name: fatcamp
description: Fatcamp — a coverage-first session generator with an articulated 3D movement rig.

scripts.build: node scripts/cache-stamp.mjs && rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json capacitor.js www/ && cp -R icons www/
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && (git checkout -- ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved 2>/dev/null || true) && npm run verify
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.verify: cmp -s index.html ios/App/App/public/index.html || { echo 'STALE web assets: run npm run sync'; exit 1; }; test -f ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved || { echo 'MISSING Package.resolved — Xcode Cloud disables automatic dependency resolution and will fail without it. Run: (cd ios/App && xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App)'; exit 1; }; echo 'ios assets in sync, Package.resolved present'
